name: Market Volatility
description: Higher market volatility can cause the system to pause or execute more frequently, leading to varied times for analyses.

name: System Load
description: The load on the system can affect its processing time, causing longer analysis times during periods of high demand.

name: Order Volume
description: Higher order volume can overwhelm the system, causing delays in analysis and execution.

name: Time of Day
description: Certain times of day may see increased trading activity, leading to longer wait times for analysis due to higher demand.

name: Day of the Week
description: Trading patterns can vary by day, with some days seeing more activity than others, affecting analysis times.

name: Server Latency
description: Latency issues can significantly impact the system's performance, especially during high-load periods.

name: Network Traffic
description: High network traffic can slow down data retrieval and processing, affecting the analysis times.

name: Software Updates
description: Periodic software updates can introduce changes that affect the system's performance, leading to unexpected delays.

name: Hardware Failure
description: Occasional hardware failures can cause significant downtime, impacting the system's ability to process analyses.

name: Energy Cost Management
description: During periods of high energy cost, the system might be throttled, leading to slower performance.

name: Cutover Periods
description: Periods when the system is transitioning to new configurations can cause disruptions and delays.

name: Resource Allocation
description: How resources are allocated can impact the system's performance, especially during high demand times.

name: Maintenance Windows
description: Scheduled maintenance can temporarily reduce system performance, affecting analysis times.

name: User Interface Performance
description: Performance issues with the user interface can indirectly affect the system, as issues are often logged there first.

name: Data Processing Queue
description: The queue for processing data can back up during high load, causing delays in analysis.
